acceptance_scope: isolated closed-domain conservation/regression probe and final-candidate combined scene generation

regression.problem: Incoming flux had outgoing direction sign, cancelling velocity on sustained throughflow.
regression.fixture: A sloping bed with identical initial water and sediment is evaluated with standing water, balanced eastward throughflow, and balanced westward throughflow.
assertions: Throughflow erosion exceeds standing-water erosion by a factor greater than 5.
East and west erosion agree within 0.0001 m.

conservation.quantity: Mean bed elevation before/after the complete authoring run including final sediment settling; proxy for solid volume on a uniform closed grid.
conservation.boundary: No water/sediment/creep exchange beyond domain edges; incoming flux is taken only from valid adjacent cells.
conservation.final_settling: Phase 7 returns all remaining suspended solid material to the bed before scratch buffers are freed.
conservation.not_measured: Water conservation is not asserted: rainfall and evaporation are explicit source/sink terms.

review.abi: WorldGenerationResult32B; eight Win64 arguments; MASM shadow space and offsets checked. Material results64B; six texture/SRV references per result cleaned exactly once.
review.dimensions: State1024x1024 RGBA32F; final height4096x4096 R32F; ecology1024x1024 RGBA16F.
review.cancellation: Callback cancellation after the first simulation dispatch returns failure with no transferred result references; final height write is not reached.
review.bindings: Input SRVs and output UAVs are unbound between phases; MASM restores CS b0/s0 and binds t19 after success.
review.cleanup: COM ownership transfer is explicit; partial failure uses RAII and application ClearState before final releases.
review.weathering: Terrain and mortar now suppress exposed neural substrate under opaque coverage; F0 remains linear and no unsupported scale/gamma is introduced.
review.memory_scope: Texture payloads only; excludes original height field, driver allocations and staging used by QA.

metrics.algorithm: virtual-pipe erosion, sediment transport and talus creep

combined_world_probe.scope: The actual final executable resource122 ran on the generated Alpine terrain. Body/head and both neural materials were freshly generated in this timeline.
combined_world_probe.conservation_scope: Combined mean_signed_height_change_m samples 65,536 locations of the nonuniform scene. It is not the full-grid closed-field conservation measure; that independent assertion remains in probe/conservation above.

limitations: Accelerated authoring erosion, sediment transport and talus creep; not a calibrated geological-time prediction.
Isolated probe uses a synthetic closed field, not the final Alpine scene.
No change to visual photorealism is certified by these numerical checks.
